expectations.buyer: Employers, platform operators, HR and workforce software vendors, works councils, labor counsel, compliance teams, and affected workers
expectations.pain: An automated hiring, scheduling, pay, performance, discipline, or termination decision lacks meaningful human oversight, explanation, contestability, or a timely appeal trail
expectations.strongestIncumbent: HRIS and case management, works-council processes, labor counsel, algorithmic-impact assessments, audit logs, regulator guidance, and employment dispute procedures
expectations.biggestRisk: Law may prohibit or require human judgment rather than a ledger, worker voice and collective bargaining are not software fields, and HR suites can bundle workflow and logs
